edge_contract_assessment.assessment: Strong endpoint timing evidence; incomplete internal parser micro-sequence proof.

simultaneous_load_lookup_assessment.intended_semantics: On a valid loaded idle phase, old-phase lookup has priority and the new load waits.
simultaneous_load_lookup_assessment.rtl_semantics: phase_load_ready is gated by lookup_valid; lookup_ready remains mapper_valid && m82_beat_ready.
simultaneous_load_lookup_assessment.sva_semantics: Every simultaneous phase_load_valid && lookup_valid requires both ready signals low.
simultaneous_load_lookup_assessment.legal_counterexample: phase_loaded=1, no poison/error, legal descriptor and m82_beat_ready=1 gives phase_load_ready=0 and lookup_ready=1.
simultaneous_load_lookup_assessment.why_dev_r2_passed: The only simultaneous attack is immediately after reset while unloaded, so mapper_valid=lookup_ready=0.
simultaneous_load_lookup_assessment.required_fix: Assert mutual exclusion of accepts, not universal rejection; separately test unloaded rejection and loaded old-phase lookup priority.

m85_differential_scope.claim: One synthetic post-commit cycle-aligned differential only.

sticky lookup error recovery through a new accepted load
reserved codes 6 and 7 or reserved code at middle/final entry

provenance_assessment.assessment: Strong posthoc consistency but not a fail-closed exact-SHA execution receipt.

findings.finding: The universal simultaneous assertion requires lookup_ready=0 whenever both valid inputs are high. The RTL and architecture intentionally allow an old-phase legal lookup to proceed while the new load is backpressured.
findings.impact: The assertion will falsely fail a required legal arbitration state; the current cover hits only the unloaded special case.
findings.required_action: Change the property to mutual exclusion of accepts and add distinct unloaded-reject and loaded-lookup-priority scenarios before freezing SHA.

findings.finding: compile_r2.log identifies paths and current files predate the run, but neither compile nor simulation log records the five source SHAs or verifies them fail-closed before launch.
findings.impact: The requested workspace SHAs match now, but exact executed bytes are not cryptographically bound by the run itself.
findings.required_action: Use an exact-SHA wrapper that verifies and emits RTL/TB/SVA/M82/M85 and output hashes.

findings.finding: The TB uses one synthetic modulo-5 metadata image. It does not replay the required 1,728 phases, 221,184 entries and 835,383 beats.
findings.impact: M99 cannot replace M85 or claim realistic coverage from this directed run.
findings.required_action: Run exact actual-record M85 differential with address/value/tag/mask/accept/output checks and randomized backpressure.

findings.finding: No same-flow 3.000 ns DC/STA, operator-family collapse, mapped area denominator, hold, or unresolved-reference report accompanies dev_r2.
findings.impact: The intended removal of the M85 unrolled cone and zero timing cost remain hypotheses, not hardware performance evidence.
findings.required_action: After actual-record VCS, run the frozen TSMC28 ideal-clock ZeroWireload DC/resource flow before any admission.

findings.finding: The SVA module has no parse_active/index/cursor/poison visibility. Exact endpoint latency is checked in TB, but sequential index progress, no wrap, per-code cursor delta and poison monotonicity are not asserted.
findings.impact: A 128-cycle implementation that skips or repeats internal work is not excluded solely by SVA.
findings.required_action: Bind or expose verification-only parser state and add the frozen progress/recurrence assertions.

findings.finding: Only one early lookup near the first audit edge is injected, followed by reset. Middle/final edge attacks and recovery by a new accepted load are not tested.
findings.impact: The sticky-error boundary and E128 collision are only partially exercised.
findings.required_action: Add index 0/63/127 attacks and reset/new-load recovery checks.

findings.finding: The three campaigns cover code5 and two wrong-base forms. Codes6/7, isolated fetch overflow, cursor overflow, zero terminal and final-entry reserved code are absent.
findings.impact: cp_metadata_error match count is state-cycle coverage, not poison-class closure.
findings.required_action: Add isolated fixed-latency attacks for every frozen poison class.

findings.finding: There is no held second load during audit, captured-image versus mutated live input test, or explicit reset-abort campaign at index 0/63/127.
findings.impact: Backpressure, atomic capture and destructive abort semantics remain statically plausible but dynamically unclosed.
findings.required_action: Add these directed scenarios before the exact-SHA freeze rerun.

findings.finding: All legal traffic comes from one deterministic modulo-5 metadata pattern and deterministic five-location output stalls.
findings.impact: Every width/escape path is touched, but realistic base distributions, phase diversity and ready/valid timing combinations are not sampled.
findings.required_action: Use actual records and seeded randomized backpressure in the admission run.

minimum_refreeze_conditions: correct simultaneous assertion to match old-phase lookup priority
cover unloaded rejection and loaded lookup-priority states separately
rerun through a fail-closed exact-SHA wrapper
